importPage.pageDescription: In this review step, participation submissions (objections from private individuals, statements from public interest bodies (PIBs), and recognised nature conservation associations) can be processed in a structured way. The AI analyses the participation submissions, extracts the individual arguments from them, and assigns them to topics. This supports the handling and review of participation submissions. The processing results can be exported in consolidated form as a CSV file, for example to provide them to the project sponsor for their responses.
importPage.step1Description: Upload all participation submissions (each in PDF format) in one ZIP file.
importPage.step2Description: The AI extracts arguments from the participation submissions and assigns them to topics.
importPage.step3Description: Review and validate the extracted arguments and topic assignments. Create a CSV file for further processing if needed.
